modules.name: Mini Painting Handle
highlights: Miniature painting handle with magnetic top and bottom end with multiple magnet options.
Threaded 2-piece hollow handle for adding weight.
Tuned to be fast to print. No assembly or clamping mechanisms. Just print and paint.

modules.name: Mini Painting Toppers
highlights: Toppers are the platform to secure your model and magnetize to the top of the mini painting handle.
Models need to be secured to toppers with poster putty, hot glue (my favorite), museum wax, etc.
Preset holes can be drilled out for pinning models directly to the topper.
Thumb grooves allow easy rotation of the model while painting.

modules.name: Mini Painting Handle Docks and Trays
highlights: Docks and Trays (Docks with carrying handles) available in multiple sizes.
Designed for bulk toppers OR handles to match your painting workflow.
Allows for bulk 'models on their own handle' painting styles-- Dock prevents tipping from accidental bumps.
Cell phone magnet plate (optional) in the handle docks allow a nearly un-tippable home for models on a handle

modules.name: Bike Grip Mini Painting Handle
highlights: Comfort-focused painting handle core designed to fit inside most bicycle handlebar grips.
Utilizes all the same toppers, trays, and docks as the fully 3d printed handle.
Fun handlebar grip shapes allow built in brush/wrist support.
Recommended for more advanced users who want to customize their handles.

modules.name: Ergonomic Brush Grip
highlights: 2 piece brush grip that threads around a brush handle with non-marring clamping collet.
Larger grip surface area allows for more varied grips - helps reduce hand strain.
Optional magnet for secure tip-down brush storage in racks.
Can be bulky and tough to get used to, but provides many ergonomic benefits.

modules.name: Ergonomic Brush Grip Rack
highlights: Safe tip-down storage for brushes inside of ergonomic brush grips.
Freestanding and wall mountable variants.
Optional magnets allow sturdy brush transportation around your workspace.

modules.name: All in One Paint Rack
highlights: Holds most major miniature paint bottles in a compact footprint.
Seamless left-right connections of multiple racks with rack connector piece.
Combine racks with module risers to scale multiple racks deep seamlessly. (Racks on racks on racks?)
Holds Citadel, Pro Acryl, AK, Vallejo, Army Painter, Golden, Scale 75, and many more!

modules.name: Basic Brush Rack
highlights: 16mm hex patterned tip-up brush storage rack.
Compact and secure way to store bulk brushes or tools.
Removable aligned lid, optionally magnetized with 6x2mm magnets.
Optional height spacer(s) can be added to customize height.

modules.name: Pro Acryl Expert Acrylics Paint Rack
highlights: Racks designed to hold Monument Hobbies Pro Acryl Expert Acrylics paint tubes.
Infinite vertical stacking with dovetail keyed connector piece.
Freestanding, Gridfinity, and wall mount variants in 2-tube and 4-tube widths.

modules.name: Primer and Medium Rack
highlights: Rack used to keep 120ml bottles from Monument Hobbies organized on you bench.
Tested with Primers, Newsh Medium, 1-step Special Sauce, and Glaze and Wash Medium.
~41mm cavity allows other similar sized bottles to fit for storage.

modules.name: Drybrush Texture Pad Palette
highlights: A simple texture pad for unloading your brush when drybrushing.
The concentric rings create sections that allow you to use it as a dry palette in a pinch.

modules.name: Brush Rinse Station
highlights: Fully printable brush rinse station.
Divided wells for clean water.
Scrubbing surface for stubborn paint.
Waterproof verified for 5 days (I gave up after that) with PLA at provided print settings.
PETG recommended for long-term use.

modules.name: Blue Brush Rinse Station Dock
highlights: Secure dock designed for the common square blue brush rinse tub you probably already have.
Provides a secure way to keep it from sliding around.
Much bigger than the fully 3D printed version and the better long term solution.

modules.name: Meeden Dry Palette Dock
highlights: Dock for the Meeden 7 well ceramic dry palette.
Textured nubs for drybrush testing/unloading a brush.
Can be used without the ceramic palette in a pinch.

modules.name: Ink Drybrush Pad Dock
highlights: Docks with an 81mm circular cutout.
Securely holds "TailaiMei Makeup Brush Color Remover" tins.
I also use it to hold "Jucoan Ceramic Watercolor Palettes" when I need a dedicated dry palette.

modules.name: Module Storage Riser
highlights: Magnetic storage risers that add extra height and usable storage to Gridfinity arrays.
Keyed alignment notches add stability when used in multiple orientations.
Large version is long enough to store extra brushes in, short version is good for smaller tools.
